propositions: DC Lucene index eventual consistency allows JQL search to miss newly-created issues, causing recover_pending to unbind a keyless-pending record and subsequent create_one to write a duplicate

the duplicate-preventing gate must reside in create_one and consult pending-binding state, not only get_jira_key, because get_jira_key returns None for keyless-pending entries regardless of their presence

keyless-pending entries must not be unbound on a single negative search; unbinding requires both search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeding a grace period (default 3600s) to corroborate genuine absence
create_one must defer the create (not drop it) when a keyless-pending binding for that local_id is younger than the grace window, leaving the pending record intact for later confirmation
recover_pending must track search misses on the pending entry and not count still-pending entries as resolved, so the gate has something to check
